name: python-frontend-evidence
body:
Design input (reference, NOT code to copy): branch origin/grafaelw-more-languages at commit 5ce53a4 'Add Python scanner frontend (ty type checker + vendored Ruff crates)', based on v0.11.1 (stale — the implementation is re-authored against current main, not cherry-picked). Reference design as described by the branch: src/pylib is a standalone Rust binary `pyfrontend` using Astral's `ty` type-checker engine + Ruff parser crates as git deps pinned to https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff tag 0.16.6 (ruff_db, ruff_python_ast, ruff_python_parser, ruff_source_file, ruff_text_size, ty_ide, ty_project, ty_python_core, ty_python_semantic, ty_module_resolver, ty_vendored, salsa; edition 2024) — the same vendored-pin pattern as src/rustlib's rust-analyzer pin; no Python runtime at scan time. Resolution: ty_ide::outgoing_calls -> Calls; goto_definition on class bases -> Uses; a resolved class/constructor call is a Uses (Function->Struct), a resolved function/method is a Calls (Function->Function); anything ty cannot resolve -> unresolved_call/unresolved_use + UnresolvedTarget with a category (Vendored -> stdlib, in-root-but-not-ours -> unknown, outside-root -> external). Schema: unified JSONL (module/file/struct/function/contains/calls/uses/unresolved*), 0-based byte start/end, 1-based start_line/end_line, erased annotation params (self/cls dropped). Module model: a directory with __init__.py/__init__.pyi is a package; the dotted FQN walks up init-bearing ancestors; a file with no init-bearing ancestor is a flat top-level module by stem. Plumbing in the reference: src/main.rs (available_languages() probe, frontend_cmd, auto-detect .py/.pyi/.pyx, id-prefix y, help text), src/classify.rs (py code_type arms), build.rs (APG_FRONTEND_PY + stage pyfrontend), install.sh (py component), Formula/apg-py.rb + scanner.rb, .gitignore (/src/pylib/target). Exclusions: __pycache__, .venv, venv, .tox, .git, .hg, .mypy_cache, .pytest_cache, .ruff_cache, node_modules, .eggs, *.egg-info.

CURRENT-BRANCH VERIFICATION (this worktree; code graph + source reads): no `python` symbol exists in the scanned graph (apg_find_symbol 'python' returned nothing), and the current plumbing has no py arm — available_languages() (src/main.rs:370-401) probes only cpp/go/rust/csharp/java-classes/tsfrontend; frontend_cmd (src/main.rs:406-455), auto_detect_languages (src/main.rs:485-504) and id_prefix_for (src/main.rs:510-520) have no py entry; builtin_code_type (src/classify.rs:78-185) has no py arm (a .py path falls to the `_ => "src"` default); build.rs (build.rs:9-23, 59-260) stages no py artifact and its default list is go/java/cpp/rust/ts/csharp. So Python is genuinely absent and the reference is not present on this branch.

SCHEMA CHECK vs the current branch (the reference is 0.11.1-era): the reference's documented emission matches the current unified schema (src/schema.rs Record enum; src/load.rs re-ingest; SPEC §2) — module{fqn}, file{path,parent,start_line,end_line}, struct{id,parent,name,path,start,end,start_line,end_line}, function{id,parent,name,params,file,path,start,end,start_line,end_line}, unresolved{fqn,category}, and the contains/calls/uses/unresolved_call/unresolved_use edge records. NO drift found in the node/edge record shapes. Two current expectations the implementation must meet: (1) struct/function deserialization has no serde defaults for path/start/end/start_line/end_line, so every Python class/def — including one in a .pyi stub — must carry full location fields; (2) lang_switch, scan_meta and planned_node are pipeline/plan-side control records, never scanner-emitted, so the Python frontend emits none of them. Internal reference inconsistency to resolve: the reference's auto-detect candidate list names .pyx while its discovery accepts only .py/.pyi — the spec pins .py/.pyi (python-accept-extensions) and records Cython as an open point. verified.
